$comment: Our 6WB Comfort elements on the panel target. Written by tools/overlay/export_wb.py (package C); do not edit by hand, re-run the script. Baked: one element per layer of bake/work/P9/stack_comfort.json (id C<n>.<layer>, mask = the layer alpha at 1x clipped to what its drawing widget shows, bbox trimmed to alpha > 0). Live: one per widget of apps/f30_cluster/hud/layouts/wb_comfort.json (id w.<widget>, z = layout z + 100, bbox = the layout box; dials carry their shader disc as mask, the rest are bbox-only). Default settings: baked on, stockMap off. See README.md.

sources.note: how the baked layers are placed (1/scale, bilinear) and which scene texture / widget draws them
wbdial: the dial widgets draw an opaque disc R = w/2 - 1

anchors.notes: from the speedo dial widget (x, y, w, h): centre = box centre, R = w/2 (the shader draws its disc to R - 1)
from the tacho dial widget (x, y, w, h): centre = box centre, R = w/2 (the shader draws its disc to R - 1)
from the fuel dial widget (x, y, w, h): centre = box centre, R = w/2 (the shader draws its disc to R - 1)
from the oilt dial widget (x, y, w, h): centre = box centre, R = w/2 (the shader draws its disc to R - 1)
the middle window: bg.tex.window rect (WBBACK draws the window texture there)
